# Theme

The components take their colors, space, corner radii, fonts, and icons from CSS variables whose names start with `--dextinity-`. You can use these variables in your own styles, and change them in your own stylesheet.

Wrap your application in [`Theme`](?path=/docs/foundations-theme-theme--docs). Outside it, the components have no styles, and the color variables have no value.

- To give the components your hues, fonts, and corner radii, see [Customize brand](?path=/docs/foundations-theme-customize-brand--docs).
- To replace or add icons, see [Customize icons](?path=/docs/foundations-icons-customize-icons--docs).
- To look up an icon, see [All icons](?path=/docs/foundations-icons-all-icons--docs).

## Use tokens in your styles

Use the semantic tokens with `var()` in your own styles. They change with the brand, the color scheme, and the density. Don't use the color scales (`--dextinity-color-<scale>-<step>`): they don't change with the color scheme.

- **Colors** of backgrounds, text, and lines.
    - `--dextinity-color-canvas`, `--dextinity-color-surface`, `--dextinity-color-surface-raised`, `--dextinity-color-surface-sunken`
    - `--dextinity-color-text`, `--dextinity-color-text-secondary`, `--dextinity-color-text-tertiary`, `--dextinity-color-text-subtle`
    - `--dextinity-color-line`, `--dextinity-color-line-strong`
    - For the accent and for feedback, such as errors: `--dextinity-color-accent-*`, `--dextinity-color-danger-*`, `--dextinity-color-warning-*`, `--dextinity-color-success-*`, `--dextinity-color-info-*`
- **Space** between and around sections, and in small groups, such as chips.
    - `--dextinity-space-1` (4px) to `--dextinity-space-12`, `--dextinity-space-panel-gap`
    - Space that follows the density: `--dextinity-density-*`, such as `--dextinity-density-panel-padding`
- **Corner radius** of surfaces, such as panels and cards, and of controls.
    - `--dextinity-radius-panel`, `--dextinity-radius-control`, `--dextinity-radius-item`, `--dextinity-radius-pill`
- **Text styles** and **fonts**.
    - `--dextinity-typography-*`, `--dextinity-font-family-text`, `--dextinity-font-family-display`, `--dextinity-font-family-mono`
- **Shadows** of raised surfaces.
    - `--dextinity-shadow-1` to `--dextinity-shadow-3`

Arrange the components with flexbox or grid, and set the space between them with `gap`:

```css
.panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: var(--dextinity-space-2);
    padding: var(--dextinity-density-panel-padding);
    border-radius: var(--dextinity-radius-panel);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--dextinity-line-width) var(--dextinity-color-line);
    background-color: var(--dextinity-color-surface);
    color: var(--dextinity-color-text);
}
```

## Color schemes, brands, and density

Set the color scheme with the `colorScheme` prop of `Theme`: `"light"`, `"dark"`, or `"high-contrast"`. The `brand` prop selects the brand, and the `density` prop the density: `"comfortable"`, `"standard"`, or `"compact"`. To use another color scheme, brand, or density in a part of the application, wrap that part in another `Theme` with its own props, see [Customize a part of the application](?path=/docs/foundations-theme-customize-brand--docs#customize-a-part-of-the-application).

`Theme` reads only its props. To follow the color scheme of the operating system, read `prefers-color-scheme` with `matchMedia`, and pass the result to `colorScheme`:
